packageRules.description: Never auto-update vendored Proton SRP code — manual re-vendor only

Gate @protontech/drive-sdk bumps behind manual dashboard approval. History: 0.15.x+ pulls a @protontech/crypto ^2.0.0 peer that ships bare .ts source (no compiled JS/.d.ts), which plain `node dist` cannot type-strip (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING) and tsc rejects (TS5097). UNBLOCKED 2026-07-23 via Tier 1: the server now runs under `tsx` (esbuild loader compiles the peer's .ts on demand), server tsconfig sets `allowImportingTsExtensions: true`, and src/types/protontech-crypto-shims.d.ts declares Uint8Array.toHex. The project now runs on 0.19.2 with @protontech/crypto pinned as an explicit dep. Manual approval + no-automerge are KEPT because each bump can carry breaking API changes: 0.17.0 dropped MaybeNode/DegradedNode and unwrapped node returns (NodeEntity, with name as a Result); 0.19.x added SRPModule.generateKeySalt and retyped SessionKey (algorithm: symmetricNames, aeadAlgorithm: aeadNames | undefined). On any future bump, re-run typecheck against drive/{client,srp-module,crypto-module}.ts and re-verify tests before merging. Isolate in its own PR, never automerge.
